framework.description: Timestamped run through one member's day: class, client call, deck work, event. Shows what GSCG membership actually involves.

structure.tip: Face on screen plus the promise as text: 'A day as an undergrad sports consultant'. No logo card.
3-4 quick clips, each with a time chip (8:00 AM).
Client call, whiteboard, deck — the proof-of-substance beat. No confidential client data on screens.
Best moment of the day: presentation, stadium, team dinner.
'Applications open <date> — link in bio.' Hold at least 3 s.

hookPatterns: POV: you consult for a pro team as an undergrad
What a sports consulting club day actually looks like
6 AM to 10 PM as a GSCG analyst
textRules: Time + place chip on every scene change
Burned-in word-level captions on any voice
Max 6-8 words per text card, top-center third
framework.musicGuidance: Lo-fi or light upbeat bed from Meta Sound Collection (IG) or YouTube Audio Library (Shorts), ducked well under any voice. Export a no-music version for in-app audio.

evidence.claim: Watch time is one of Instagram's top three ranking signals (Mosseri, Jan 2025) [A]
Schools that embraced TikTok and student-led storytelling jumped 100+ places in 2025 higher-ed engagement rankings [B]
45-60 s is the best-performing Reel length band (0.35% ER, 10,374 median views) [B]
WEAK: no dataset isolates day-in-the-life format performance; format choice is a heuristic

reels.soundOffShare: 69% of US adults watch video with sound off in public (Verizon Media/Publicis 2019 survey, cross-platform; no verified Reels-specific figure) [C]
reels.engagementBenchmark: Avg ER/post by followers: Reels 0.52%, carousels 0.55%, images 0.37% (Socialinsider 2025) [B]. 1-5K-follower accounts: ~580 views, ~3 comments, ~1 save per Reel [B]. Best length band 45-60 s: 0.35% ER, 10,374 median views [B].
notes: Top ranking signals: watch time, likes, sends; sends weigh more for non-followers, likes for followers (Mosseri, Jan 2025) [A]. Track average watch time, likes per reach, sends per reach.
45-60 s is the best-performing length band; >180 s Reels are excluded from the Reels tab and drop to 0.15% ER [B].
Original content is favored; reposts/aggregated content less likely to be recommended [A].
Business accounts may lack the licensed music library; use Meta Sound Collection (14,000+ royalty-free tracks) [A]. Export a no-music version so the team can add cleared audio in-app.
Trial Reels (non-follower-first testing) need 1,000+ followers and a public account; GSCG (~440) not yet eligible [A].
Carousels out-view Reels at the 1-5K tier (993 vs 580 avg views) — ship a carousel twin for announcements and listicles [B].
Keep text out of the bottom ~35% and top ~10% (conservative; sources disagree on exact safe zone) [C].
Accounts <1K followers saw Reels engagement +30% YoY even as overall Reels views fell 59% (Metricool 2025) [B].
Cadence: 3-5 posts/week gives ~12% more reach per post than 1-2/week (Buffer, 2M+ posts) [B].

shorts.engagementBenchmark: No official threshold. Third-party targets: ~70%+ 'stayed to watch' (viewed vs swiped) and ~80%+ average % viewed [C]. Shorts engagement fell 36% YoY while output rose 61% (Metricool 2025) [B].
notes: Up to 3 min; Shorts over 1 min must be uploaded via YouTube Studio, not the Shorts camera [A].
A Short over 1 min with ANY Content ID claim is blocked globally — keep licensed music to <60 s Shorts; YouTube Audio Library tracks are claim-free [A].
Shorts audio-library songs mostly capped at 90 s, some 60 or 30 s [A].
Since 31 Mar 2025 public views count every start/replay; benchmark against 'Engaged views' in Analytics [A].

youtube.engagementBenchmark: Target >=60% of viewers still watching at 30 s ('Intro' retention), >65% for strong hooks (vidIQ, vendor) [C]. Engagement roughly flat 1-5 min, drops significantly past 5 min (Wistia 2024, all hosted video) [B].
notes: Use for full semester/trip recap films, speaker/panel recordings, case-competition walkthroughs.
Prove the title's promise in the first ~10 s; add chapters; cut 3-5 Shorts from each long video (practitioner heuristic).
hookSeconds here = the 30 s intro-retention checkpoint YouTube reports, not a 2-3 s scroll hook.

linkedin.soundOffShare: Video autoplays muted in feed; no official LinkedIn sound-off % found. Cross-platform: 69% sound-off in public (2019 survey) [C]
linkedin.engagementBenchmark: ER by impressions 2025: video 6.00%, native document 7.00%, multi-image 6.45%, image 5.30%, text 4.50% (Socialinsider, pages 1K-1M) [B]. Videos get 1.4x more engagement than other posts (LinkedIn data via Axios) [C].
notes: LinkedIn guidance: awareness video 15-30 s, deeper content under 2 min; square or vertical (1:1 or 9:16) perform better on mobile; hook in first 3 s; add captions [A].
4:5 is a feed-safe compromise between LinkedIn's 1:1 and 9:16 recommendations (heuristic, not LinkedIn-specified).
Video viewership +36% YoY; video creation growing 2x other formats (LinkedIn rep via Digiday) [A].
LinkedIn warns blurry visuals or poor audio 'immediately lose credibility' — prioritize clean voice on testimonials [A].
Lead with outcome/credibility (client, deliverable, skill), not vibes; audience is recruiters, alumni, client staff.
Best day: Wednesday, then Thursday/Friday (Buffer, 4.8M posts) [B].
Logo visible in first 2 s: +17% CTR on video ads (LinkedIn Creative Lab, secondhand) [C].

linkedin-wide.soundOffShare: Video autoplays muted in feed; no official LinkedIn sound-off % found [C]
linkedin-wide.engagementBenchmark: Same LinkedIn format benchmarks as 'linkedin' (video 6.00% ER by impressions, Socialinsider 2025) [B]. LinkedIn says square/vertical tend to perform better than landscape on mobile [A].
notes: Use only for landscape-shot interviews/testimonials, panels, or content shared with long-form YouTube.
Burn in captions large enough to read at small feed size; landscape occupies less screen on mobile.
